contexts.text: While man is being reformed, which is effected by means of combats and temptations, evil Spirits are associated with him...
Man associates to himself Societies, or puts himself into the society of such, for like is associated with like. Example(s).
Those truths which have entered, are reproduced when a similar delight recurs, together with many others with which they have associated or conjoined themselves.
They who yield, come into confirmation of evil, and into persuasion of falsity, for then the evil Spirits with them conquer, and they are thus associated with them...
Both we () = both those who are associated.
That Spirits are associated with man according to his loves, has been made known to me by much experience...
Hence it is... that (after death) they are first associated with Angels... TCR 798.
Every man, after death, betakes himself to his own in that Interspace, and associates himself with those who are in similar love...
